info.title: API.SH: GOAT
info.description: The GOAT API from API.SH: public GOAT data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: Route prefix, e.g. /tiktok/v1

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO time.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor from `next`.

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
The suggestions GOAT's search box shows for a partial query: products (id, name, slug, category, image) and collections.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/goat-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What has been typed so far.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/goat-product

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products GOAT recommends alongside a product (similar styles): name, SKU, brand, colour, category, release date, lowest and display price, image and size range. Identify the product by id, by its goat.com link, or by q (the first search result).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/goat-related

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: GOAT's numeric product id (from search). One of id, url or q is required.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A goat.com product link.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words; the first result is used.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: How many products (1-50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Filter by brand, category, product type, activity, gender, colour, silhouette (model line), release year, condition, size and price range. Facet filters take the `slug` values listed in `facets` (comma-separated for several); `applied_filters` echoes the filters in effect.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/goat-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words. May be left out when a brand, category or other facet filter is given, which lists that brand or category.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (lowest ask for the price sorts). Default relevance.

parameters.name: sort_type
parameters.description: GOAT's own numeric sortType, passed as-is (overrides `sort`).

parameters.name: instant_ship
parameters.description: Only products available with Instant Ship.

parameters.name: under_retail
parameters.description: Only products selling under retail price.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand slug(s) from `facets.brands`, comma-separated, e.g. nike or nike,air-jordan.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug(s) from `facets.categories`, e.g. footwear, apparel, bags.

parameters.name: product_type
parameters.description: Product type slug(s) (nested under `facets.categories`), e.g. sneakers, tops, boots.

parameters.name: activity
parameters.description: Activity slug(s) (nested under `facets.categories`), e.g. basketball, running, lifestyle.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Gender slug(s) from `facets.genders`: men, women, youth, infant.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Colour slug(s) from `facets.colors`, e.g. black or white,black.

parameters.name: silhouette
parameters.description: Model line(s), the product's `silhouette` in slug form (lowercase, hyphens), e.g. air-jordan-1, dunk or yeezy-boost-350; comma-separated for several.

parameters.name: release_year
parameters.description: Release year(s), e.g. 2022 or 2022,2023.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Only products offered in this condition (comma-separated for several): new_no_defects, new_with_defects, used.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Only products with an offer in this size, e.g. 10, 10.5 (US shoe sizes) or m (apparel); comma-separated for several. Uses the single `gender` given (default men) and `size_type`. A size code such as us_shoes_women_8 is passed as-is.

parameters.name: size_type
parameters.description: What `size` refers to: shoes (default for numbers), tops (default for letters), bottoms, outerwear, dresses.

parameters.name: min_price_cents
parameters.description: Lowest price, in cents (e.g. 10000 = $100).

parameters.name: max_price_cents
parameters.description: Highest price, in cents.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

products.name: Fragment Design x Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG SP 'Sail Military Blue'

get.description:
Every size of a GOAT product with its lowest ask, the condition and box condition of that offer, stock status, the instant-ship ask and the last sold price, plus the full list of size, condition and box-condition combinations. Prices are in cents. Pass `q` to open the first current search result, or an `id` or product `url`. Pass `size` for the price of one size only. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/goat-sizes

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words; the first current result is used. Either q, id or url is required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: GOAT product id (the `id` from /goat/v1/search).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A GOAT product link (https://www.goat.com/sneakers/<slug>) or its slug.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Only offers in this condition.

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: Only sizes and conditions that have an ask right now.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: One size only, e.g. 10, 10.5 or M (as in `sizes[].size`). 404 when the product does not list that size.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter market code (default US).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
